scope: Primary-source applicability review and existing>=32K evidence; no new GPU benchmark, kernel change or speed/adoption proof.

findings.fact: A lane owns a cell and accumulates the dot in dimension order with subgroup query broadcasts. SG16/SG32, single-work-group all-chunk and split-K choices exist. Softmax/merge and fp8 storage differ from the accepted B570 int8 paged/stateful path.
findings.implication: Promising memory/launch strategy, not an exact-arithmetic drop-in. A new B570 candidate must preserve quantized scale/page semantics, check subgroup uniformity, avoid typed-vector alias assumptions, and qualify full>=32K math/state before speed.

findings.fact: Reference explicitly ports Strata block scores/radix top-k, with ascending lowest-index threshold ties. BF16 contiguous key/indexer geometry and FP32 scores differ from the engine FP32 pooled/dead representation.
findings.implication: Its improvement over a PyTorch einsum/topk baseline is not an independent speed improvement over this existing native selector. Do not replace key representation/rounding based only on author timing.

findings.fact: Reference fuses grouped norm and mix/combine epilogues around BF16 projections. Existing compiled Strata already uses gr_norm_rs and gr_write_norm_rs, with optional gr_upmix.
findings.implication: Audit remaining projection/epilogue launches and actual numerical order before importing a fusion idea; no claim that these full-engine paths were measured or copied.

findings.fact: Previous ABBA jobs on their historical base compared fresh-process32K default/batch128-layout1 at408.300/408.357 mean PP tok/s, relative+0.01385%. Only one input per process in that older comparison.
findings.implication: No useful evidence for a batch-only prefill gain; do not repeat it merely after rebasing DD5. Current DD5 qualification keeps the accepted batch32/layout1 geometry.

future_candidate_constraints: Do not use masked expert misses or no-victim-writeback quality changes as exact-math optimizations.
No additional GPU job or CPU-heavy build during the active full DD5 gate.
Any new performance comparison must have>=32768 fresh input tokens, separate process first/later full reads, no profiler/diagnostic logs.
Before adoption complete physical262144 occupancy/repeated full/session restore/clipped/refusal/later valid>=32K.
